fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff:
MBA [NCR-057]: 2026–27 CAT-route counselling, Round 3 (3 August 2026), closing merit ranks: Shift I: Delhi General 233 (Outside Delhi General cell blank; no Shift II row in CAT Round 3). These are GGSIPU allotment ranks, not CAT percentiles; category and shift apply.

MBA (International Business) [NCR-190]: 2026–27 CAT-route counselling, Round 3 (3 August 2026), closing merit ranks: Shift I: Delhi General 159; Outside Delhi General 475. These are GGSIPU allotment ranks, not CAT percentiles; category and shift apply.
fields.Eligibility:
MBA [NCR-057]: Bachelor’s degree; current minimum-mark/category rules not located in an official 2026 notice

MBA (International Business) [NCR-190]: Recognised bachelor degree of at least three years with 50% marks; official MBA-IB FAQ states 45% for SC/ST, subject to current university rules.
fields.Selection Process:
MBA [NCR-057]: GGSIPU central counselling by CAT/CMAT/CET merit, document verification and seat allotment.

MBA (International Business) [NCR-190]: GGSIPU central counselling through CAT/CMAT and other notified routes; apply through university registration and choice filling. No institute GD/PI weighting is stated.
